4a587dc29f8a26ce.en: The materials establish the absence of new arguments and the earlier substantive responses. Mechanically counting registration notices does not replace a decision.
4a587dc29f8a26ce.zh: 材料已确立没有新理由及存在此前实质性答复的条件。机械统计登记通知不能代替决定。

bcb222eeeecbbe27.en: A blanket ban on appeals has been proposed instead of a decision on a specific issue.
bcb222eeeecbbe27.zh: 提出了全面禁止诉求的做法，而非针对具体问题作出决定。

1506dceb995a3aef.en: A manager or an official specified by law may decide that the further appeal is unfounded and end correspondence. No decision has been made. Your workstation is for registration and preparation of materials and does not carry this power.
1506dceb995a3aef.zh: 负责人或法律规定的官员有权认定再次提出的诉求缺乏依据并终止往来。目前尚未作出决定。你的岗位负责登记和准备材料，不具备该权限。

d007b8fa56b28570.en: Materials from one authority: three earlier written substantive responses to the same issue, followed by a fourth letter. No new arguments or circumstances. Comparison is complete; their presence is not disputed in this exercise.
d007b8fa56b28570.zh: 同一机关的材料包括针对同一问题的三份此前书面实质性答复，以及随后的第四封信。没有新理由或新情况。比对已完成；本练习对此不存在争议。

1d775d3f036a40ea.en: The letter arrived on {{received}}. The author repeats the earlier arguments and attaches the same photographs. It has a signature and a reply address.
1d775d3f036a40ea.zh: 信函于{{received}}收到。作者重复此前理由，附件照片也与之前相同。具备签名和答复地址。

eb1b53311c8ef517.en: The law gives the authorised official the right to decide when the combined conditions are met; a registration employee cannot replace that decision with a letter counter.
eb1b53311c8ef517.zh: 法律在全部条件满足时赋予有权人员决定权；登记工作人员不能用信函计数器替代决定。

33cad89f18b65b03.en: The conditions to consider ending correspondence are present, but termination itself is not automatic.
33cad89f18b65b03.zh: 已具备考虑终止往来的条件，但终止本身并不自动发生。

dea8af625387e6e2.en: The fourth letter is already deemed deleted by law.
dea8af625387e6e2.zh: 第四封信依法已被视为删除。

a9867bc3c4816e7e.en: Any change in a letter’s date is always a new material circumstance.
a9867bc3c4816e7e.zh: 信函日期的任何变化始终构成新的重要情况。

cde2611d42ac46ef.en: What is established, and what does not yet follow from the materials?
cde2611d42ac46ef.zh: 材料已确立什么，哪些结论尚不能得出？

258f7adda12ddfcd.en: Ending correspondence on the old issue is not a permanent ban on other appeals or new circumstances.
258f7adda12ddfcd.zh: 就旧问题终止往来，并非永久禁止其他诉求或新情况。

14956f97a1add35d.en: Check the subject and limits of the earlier decision.
14956f97a1add35d.zh: 核查此前决定的事项和范围。

57d6a813c325c900.en: After the manager ends correspondence on the old issue, the same citizen reports newly damaged support equipment at another site. The new photograph and location were absent from the earlier materials.
57d6a813c325c900.zh: 负责人决定就旧问题终止往来后，同一公民报告另一地点的支撑设施新损坏。新照片和地点均未包含在此前材料中。

7c7e886f30334725.en: Delete the new report because of the earlier decision.
7c7e886f30334725.zh: 依据此前决定删除新报告。

eb92b96ce70b25fe.en: Register and assess the new report; the earlier decision concerns a defined issue and does not replace examination of new circumstances.
eb92b96ce70b25fe.zh: 登记并评估新报告；此前决定针对特定问题，不能替代对新情况的核查。

0e49b9140771fc24.en: Attach the old notice as proof that a different support is sound.
0e49b9140771fc24.zh: 附上旧通知，作为另一支撑设施完好的证明。

63ea1100bf6121d9.en: Every employee must automatically end correspondence after the fourth letter.
63ea1100bf6121d9.zh: 第四封信后，任何员工都必须自动终止往来。

d917f336b4b04f00.en: The number of previous responses permanently bans every appeal from the citizen.
d917f336b4b04f00.zh: 此前答复次数可以永久禁止该公民的一切诉求。

53b33662c79aadb5.en: I am writing again about the same lights. I have no new photographs, but I disagree with the earlier responses. The reception office said that because this is my fourth letter, it can be deleted immediately.
53b33662c79aadb5.zh: 我再次反映同样的灯具问题。没有新照片，但我不同意此前答复。接待处说，这是第四封信，可以直接删除。

9e07ec0a50f7f041.en: No. The responses I have contain no such decision.
9e07ec0a50f7f041.zh: 没有，我已有的答复中没有这样的决定。

2153d3e082820399.en: A written decision still needs to be checked; it does not arise automatically.
2153d3e082820399.zh: 还需核查是否存在书面决定，它不会自动产生。

31bc3914682ff72f.en: Have you received a notice ending correspondence?
31bc3914682ff72f.zh: 你是否收到过终止往来通知？

c5d751f70ea72a55.en: There are no new circumstances. I ask you to reconsider the same arguments; I did not alter the date on the old photograph.
c5d751f70ea72a55.zh: 没有新情况。我请求重新审视相同理由，没有修改旧照片的日期。

51010740dec496dc.en: The case conditions provide no new arguments or circumstances.
51010740dec496dc.zh: 题设没有新理由或新情况。

37f182ba359f999e.en: What new circumstances are you reporting?

792e56900f02ea87.en: All three responses came from the same authority. I attached copies.
792e56900f02ea87.zh: 三份答复都来自同一机关，我附上了副本。

b8ca23a696e81a50.en: Responses from one authority are available for comparison.
b8ca23a696e81a50.zh: 可供比对的是同一机关的答复。

f873220230144337.en: Automatically delete the letter without a decision or notice.
f873220230144337.zh: 未经决定和通知，自动删除信函。

82f9bc5781055c6a.en: Forbid the citizen from submitting any future appeals.
82f9bc5781055c6a.zh: 禁止该公民今后提出任何诉求。

2efa28e4eb90da8e.en: Register the material and present the comparison to the authorised official for a decision on further consideration or ending correspondence on this issue.
2efa28e4eb90da8e.zh: 登记材料，将比对结果交给有权人员，决定继续审理还是就本问题终止往来。

ec98325d4baf7b17.zh: 又是同样的问题——由谁决定？

c825c4150f8200c4.en: Distinguish the existence of grounds, the power to decide and notification of the adopted decision.
c825c4150f8200c4.zh: 需要区分依据是否存在、谁有决定权，以及如何告知已作出的决定。

303a1aed01a500f6.en: Check the conditions and submit materials to the authorised official: the right to decide is not an automatic duty of every employee.
303a1aed01a500f6.zh: 核查条件并将材料交有权人员：决定权并不等于每名员工的自动义务。

017831a6d102dc99.en: Do not register the material or retain earlier responses.
017831a6d102dc99.zh: 不登记材料，也不保留此前答复。

e95428cbbfbb34b9.en: Assistant: “If Part 5 of Article 11’s conditions are met, the registration employee must independently end correspondence.”
e95428cbbfbb34b9.zh: 助手：“只要第11条第5款的条件满足，登记工作人员就必须自行终止往来。”

a67e28027bcd5bf3.en: Based solely on the building’s location.

75cfe973483839a5.zh: 不得宣布责任已被确认。

2f507efec46d2dbb.en: Notify the applicant of the next steps

44ee2b987cf3f4d3.en: The specific supervisory authority depends on verified circumstances.
44ee2b987cf3f4d3.zh: 具体监督机关的选择取决于经核实的情况。

5f571e76912dd864.en: Clarify the outfall and the division of authority
5f571e76912dd864.zh: 核实排水口及权限划分

19ea6888659d7cf9.en: Distinguish observed facts from assumptions about the business.
19ea6888659d7cf9.zh: 区分观察到的事实与对企业的推测。

2ec58a950c4d4c1b.en: You may not impose such additional conditions independently.
2ec58a950c4d4c1b.zh: 不得自行设定这类附加条件。

45671052a4cb0fed.en: Refuse until the citizen pays for laboratory analysis
45671052a4cb0fed.zh: 在公民支付实验室检测费用前拒绝受理

665d85c0020da445.en: Do not promise inspections or penalties on another authority’s behalf.
665d85c0020da445.zh: 不得代表其他机关承诺检查或处罚。

c971c0f4943db1d5.en: Prepare referral under the established remit
c971c0f4943db1d5.zh: 按已确定的管辖权准备转交

2c35cef06b8726ef.en: Forwarding materials does not itself solve the problem.
2c35cef06b8726ef.zh: 转交材料本身并不解决问题。

3df314e574a71f01.en: Keep monitoring receipt of the outcome
3df314e574a71f01.zh: 继续跟踪是否收到处理结果

bf2e062eff6f501f.en: The written appeal has been accepted, with a photograph and plan attached. The card gives receipt and registration dates. You prepare a draft response; no extension applies.
bf2e062eff6f501f.zh: 已受理书面诉求，附有照片和示意图。登记卡注明收件和登记日期。你负责拟定答复，未适用延期。

ae1bf13388af5b5c.en: Calculate the last permissible day to answer the registered written appeal. The scenario includes no extension. Use the events and dates from this specific instance of the case.
ae1bf13388af5b5c.zh: 计算答复已登记书面诉求的最后允许日期。题设未办理延期。请使用本次具体案件实例中的事件和日期。

fa3c6c55981f51ff.en: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
fa3c6c55981f51ff.zh: 本教学案件的计算规则：不计起算当日，计算全部自然日；末日为非工作日时顺延至下一个工作日。本规则由题设指定，并不自动适用于所有程序。

5374c53f45297946.en: Identify the triggering event and units of counting, then calculate the date for your set of events.
5374c53f45297946.zh: 确定起算事件和计时单位，再根据你这组事件计算日期。

af573fe9f5a8ffec.en: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
af573fe9f5a8ffec.zh: 在角色权限内行动。相互独立的行动可以采用不同顺序。

4426b8522c5cc14e.en: The general response period runs from registration; it is not a guaranteed deadline for eliminating pollution.
4426b8522c5cc14e.zh: 一般答复期限从登记起算，不能视为保证消除污染的期限。

04366c7d43ace1c8.en: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
04366c7d43ace1c8.zh: 听取诉求并核实事实。案件标题不能决定哪些行动正确。

fdca44d4a74ddea2.en: Exceeding authority and imposing a penalty without established facts.
fdca44d4a74ddea2.zh: 超越权限，并在事实未明时实施处罚。

f7629f4c5cb416a0.en: Training photograph dated {{observed}}: dark water is visible at a pipe outfall. The materials do not identify the outfall’s owner; no sampling results exist.
f7629f4c5cb416a0.zh: {{observed}}的教学照片显示，管道排水口有深色水流。材料未说明排水口所有者，也没有采样结果。

2a1f426983b37210.en: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The appeal reached the recipient preparing the response. No extension was granted.
2a1f426983b37210.zh: {{sent}}发送，{{received}}收到，{{registered}}登记。诉求已到达负责拟答复的收件人，未办理延期。

9a2ca773918f7563.en: The observation and photograph justify arranging consideration but do not prove the water’s composition or culpability. The source and applicable remit need clarification.
9a2ca773918f7563.zh: 观察和照片足以促成审理，但不能证明水体成分或责任。需要核实来源及适用管辖权。

139cfc69f6ff7297.en: The neighbouring business’s culpability is already proven.
139cfc69f6ff7297.zh: 附近企业的责任已经证实。

a5a1c9e0c09b4216.en: Without test results, the appeal need not be considered.
a5a1c9e0c09b4216.zh: 没有检测结果就无需审理诉求。

f0abc37b989dab59.en: Visible signs of possible pollution have been reported; the source and composition are not yet established.
f0abc37b989dab59.zh: 已报告可能污染的外观迹象，来源和成分尚未确定。

f687d4fad1c6673f.en: What can be stated from the available materials?
f687d4fad1c6673f.zh: 依据现有材料可以确认什么？

e6e37fad7e9d93af.en: Monitoring concerns the substance of the response: the outfall issue remains unresolved, and a photograph alone does not prove culpability.
e6e37fad7e9d93af.zh: 跟踪针对答复实质内容：排水口问题仍未解决，照片本身不能证明责任。

b389b2d3559df196.en: The outfall issue has not received substantive examination.
b389b2d3559df196.zh: 排水口问题尚未得到实质核查。

83c9d83028bc2a7b.en: Training follow-up: the relevant authority replied only about the neighbouring business, without identifying who owns the pipe outfall. The citizen sent a new photograph of the same location.
83c9d83028bc2a7b.zh: 教学后续情境：专业机关仅答复了附近企业情况，未说明管道排水口属于谁。公民又发来同一地点的新照片。

2a46cd3f4d3c21a0.en: Compare the response with the appeal and request clarification of the unresolved issue.
2a46cd3f4d3c21a0.zh: 比对答复与诉求，就尚未解决的问题请求补充说明。

e28e1ad9b8a14086.en: Close the case because any letter counts as a complete response.
e28e1ad9b8a14086.zh: 认为任意信函都算完整答复，因此结案。

d5386a4cd4ab35ea.en: Declare the business culpable from the new photo without verification.
d5386a4cd4ab35ea.zh: 不核查，仅凭新照片就认定企业有责。

d1a1c90a7e9aa113.en: The clarification was prepared without replacing evidence with assumptions.
d1a1c90a7e9aa113.zh: 补充说明已拟好，未用推测替代证据。

c3cbf81cdde33c43.en: All repairs and pollution removal are guaranteed within 30 days.
c3cbf81cdde33c43.zh: 保证在30天内完成一切维修并消除污染。

f0ee95a779ece49e.en: The period starts only after the responsible party is identified.
f0ee95a779ece49e.zh: 只有查明责任人后才开始计算期限。

9f1b117c2c6a58b2.en: Find the provision on the time limit for considering a written appeal.
9f1b117c2c6a58b2.zh: 查找书面诉求审理期限的规定。

586f4033d6a2b7f8.en: Near Kolomenskoye I noticed dark water by a pipe and a strong smell. There is a business nearby; it is probably dumping everything. Please punish those responsible immediately. I brought a photograph and marked the location on a plan.
586f4033d6a2b7f8.zh: 在科洛缅斯科耶附近，我看到管道旁有深色水流和刺鼻气味。旁边有家企业，大概就是它在排放。请立即处罚责任人。我带了照片，并在图上标出了位置。

99e727e7fc99c57d.en: Check that you have not presented an assumption as proven fact or exceeded your authority.
99e727e7fc99c57d.zh: 检查是否把推测当作已证实事实，或超越权限。

cc7e50c39cd5cb70.en: The plan distinguishes observations, assumptions and further verification.
cc7e50c39cd5cb70.zh: 计划区分了观察、推测和进一步核查。

77eb9f8dda031bd7.en: Provision of a public service through a multifunctional centre
77eb9f8dda031bd7.zh: 通过多功能政务服务中心提供政务服务

13269188e2ac5f54.en: An appeal under 59-FZ plus prompt reporting of danger
13269188e2ac5f54.zh: 依据59-FZ办理诉求，并及时报告危险信息

553937920a6dfe43.zh: 依据8-FZ提出的公开信息请求

06d8537058135de5.en: I do not know of anyone injured. I have not been to the river today.
06d8537058135de5.zh: 我不知道有没有人受伤，今天也没去河边。

b3a64c9bf7e7bcc8.en: Is there information about a current threat to people?
b3a64c9bf7e7bcc8.zh: 是否有当前威胁人身安全的信息？

3126239a48319cf2.en: I did not establish it. It is simply nearby. I did not see where the water enters the pipe.
3126239a48319cf2.zh: 我没有证实，只是它就在附近。我没看到水从哪里流入管道。

1477f9ce236d3c92.en: The link between the business and the discharge is an assumption.
1477f9ce236d3c92.zh: 企业与排放之间的联系属于推测。

641d8b777f8f1e1d.en: How did you establish that this business caused the discharge?
641d8b777f8f1e1d.zh: 你如何确定排放由该企业造成？

c469b4c2540798c6.en: By the river near Kolomenskoye. The photograph was taken on {{observed}}; I marked the site on the plan.
c469b4c2540798c6.zh: 在科洛缅斯科耶附近河边。照片摄于{{observed}}，地点已在图上标明。

69b0b8bc1085241b.en: The observation’s location and date are established.
69b0b8bc1085241b.zh: 观察地点和日期已确定。

2183fe68ffd28443.en: Where is the pipe and when was the photograph taken?
2183fe68ffd28443.zh: 管道在哪里，照片何时拍摄？

e2d6bd2f4f37d135.en: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
e2d6bd2f4f37d135.zh: 教学模型。你受理诉求，拟定按管辖权转交材料及通知。不得行使其他机关权限。

6c37ce1dc3a9eecd.en: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
6c37ce1dc3a9eecd.zh: 莫斯科行政机关接待处

b3b0df26b703633d.en: Clarify the outfall and remit, then prepare materials for the appropriate environmental authority
b3b0df26b703633d.zh: 核实排水口及权限，再为相应环境保护机关准备材料

758ac270abfff0ea.en: Send the complaint to the suspected offender for final resolution
758ac270abfff0ea.zh: 将投诉交涉嫌责任方最终处理

0d33ebc55a71b2a9.en: Impose a fine on behalf of the reception office without establishing the facts
0d33ebc55a71b2a9.zh: 未查明情况即以接待处名义罚款

26d0e1766f360463.en: Find the provision and check applicability. A click count cannot replace information from external sources.
26d0e1766f360463.zh: 查找规定并核查适用性。点击次数不能替代外部来源的信息。

34056b5385b295bd.en: A building’s location does not prove the source, composition or a violation. The reception office does not impose penalties.
34056b5385b295bd.zh: 建筑物位置不能证明来源、成分或违法事实。接待处不实施处罚。

6a6e1d37083165e7.en: Distinguish observation from assumption and establish the source and basis for further action.
6a6e1d37083165e7.zh: 区分观察与推测，确定来源及后续行动依据。

ecf4f61ccdebf5ad.en: The assistant says: “If a business is near the outfall, the photograph already proves its culpability.”
ecf4f61ccdebf5ad.zh: 助手声称：“只要排水口附近有企业，照片就已经证明该企业有责。”

7fa19446fa85146f.en: Note the photograph’s age and request available information about the current state
7fa19446fa85146f.zh: 注明照片拍摄时间，索取可获取的当前情况信息

8bbb8e407ca0d0d5.en: The repeat letter includes a photograph. The original file’s date is in the materials; the registration date is on the calendar card.
8bbb8e407ca0d0d5.zh: 再次来信附有照片。原文件日期在材料中，登记日期在日历卡上。

fe8fe281d6753f4a.en: Original file date: {{observed}}. Letter received on {{received}}. The applicant forwarded the original file without a new photograph.
fe8fe281d6753f4a.zh: 原文件日期为{{observed}}，信函于{{received}}收到。申请人转发的是原文件，没有新照片。

a621eff2c8af6c1f.en: Received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. No new photographs exist at registration.
a621eff2c8af6c1f.zh: {{received}}收到，{{registered}}登记。登记时没有新照片。

768418beb829f589.en: The source’s age matters. An old photo must not be labelled a current observation, but the appeal must still be considered under the applicable procedure.
768418beb829f589.zh: 来源时间很重要。不能把旧照片标为当前观察，但仍应按适用程序审理诉求。

ffd74901743d2b39.en: There is a historical observation; the current state needs clarification.
ffd74901743d2b39.zh: 已有历史观察，当前状态仍需核实。

1454e3b7f397d30e.en: I am writing again about that pipe. An acquaintance sent me a photo and I forwarded it as today’s. Only now did I notice the file seems to have been made last year.
1454e3b7f397d30e.zh: 我再次反映那条管道。熟人发来照片，我把它当作今天的转给了你们。现在才发现，文件似乎是去年拍的。

cd84e055e12e592a.en: Return to the dates and check what the old photograph actually establishes.
cd84e055e12e592a.zh: 重新查看日期，核实旧照片实际能证明什么。

fd56e86998f8905d.en: The observation date is considered; the current state is not presented as confirmed.
fd56e86998f8905d.zh: 已考虑观察日期，未将当前状态表述为已确认。

dbc1427dd09ae956.en: The file properties show {{observed}}. I have no recent photograph.
dbc1427dd09ae956.zh: 文件属性显示{{observed}}。我没有近期照片。

6fbb369ccf49508a.en: This photograph does not establish the current state.
6fbb369ccf49508a.zh: 这张照片不能确定当前状态。

b1d9ec6e16c8e305.en: What date is in the original file?
b1d9ec6e16c8e305.zh: 原文件中标注什么日期？

cfbf45d525289219.en: Not yet. I ask you to investigate; I am not claiming this is definitely happening today.
cfbf45d525289219.zh: 暂时没有。我请求调查，并非断言今天一定还在发生。

4dfa8cc9c0e1d921.en: The applicant is clarifying the report, not providing evidence of the current state.
4dfa8cc9c0e1d921.zh: 申请人在澄清报告，并非提供当前状态的证据。

10b15660254481a7.en: Is there another observation from the current period?
10b15660254481a7.zh: 是否还有当前时期的其他观察？

6ef2f4f9861f269c.en: I wrote the new letter after my acquaintance forwarded the photograph. There are no other new observations yet.
6ef2f4f9861f269c.zh: 熟人转发照片后，我写了新信。目前没有其他新观察。

28998b15d46c8c57.en: The repeat letter is not accompanied by a recent observation.
28998b15d46c8c57.zh: 再次来信没有附带近期观察。

bd116edd9dfe6ab0.en: What has changed since the previous appeal?
bd116edd9dfe6ab0.zh: 与上次诉求相比有什么变化？

d5b7ca6e114baaaa.en: Compare the requested items with documents relating to the applicant’s work
d5b7ca6e114baaaa.zh: 比对请求清单与申请人工作相关文件

6cc43e2a2ba83097.en: Check proof of submission and the written fee demand
6cc43e2a2ba83097.zh: 核查提交证明及书面收费要求

302353a3c11baf27.en: Prepare consideration of the refusal by an authorised official
302353a3c11baf27.zh: 准备由有权人员审查拒绝行为

c1e723085580a578.en: Explain that proper copies are free and that the employer has a separate deadline
c1e723085580a578.zh: 说明适当副本应免费提供，以及雇主单独适用的期限

d6033647638dd1ab.en: Check that the actual documents requested were issued
d6033647638dd1ab.zh: 核查是否实际提供了所请求的具体文件

cce04f17f66224cb.en: Require payment for copies as a mandatory condition
cce04f17f66224cb.zh: 将支付复印费用作为强制条件

a076d107679528ee.en: Require the applicant to bring payroll records for all employees
a076d107679528ee.zh: 要求申请人提供所有员工工资记录

fd9a3746edc05dc8.en: On an employee’s written request, the employer must provide work-related documents and properly certified copies free of charge within three working days of submission. This is not the inspectorate’s general complaint-response deadline.
fd9a3746edc05dc8.zh: 劳动者提出书面申请后，雇主应在提交之日起三个工作日内免费提供与其工作相关的文件及经适当认证的副本。这不是劳动监察机构答复投诉的一般期限。

51871e071c1fe3b7.en: Requiring the applicant to bring payroll records for all employees exceeds the stated remit or creates an unjustified risk.
51871e071c1fe3b7.zh: 要求申请人提供所有员工工资记录，超出了指定权限或造成无正当理由的风险。

c4aadbc60b674f70.en: The request is for the applicant’s salary certificate for one period and a certified copy of their hiring order. Submission of the written request is confirmed. It does not concern other employees or their salaries.
c4aadbc60b674f70.zh: 申请人请求一个期间的本人工资证明及入职命令的认证副本。已确认提交书面申请。申请不涉及其他员工及其工资。
